The Nifty faces overhead supply at 23,400 amidst persistent institutional distribution, a condition where Stan Weinstein warns Stage 2 breakout failure rates rise substantially. analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Discipline

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price trades above the 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, sitting within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot with 2x volume expansion and positive MACD. However, the pattern lacks a tight volatility contraction pattern (VCP), and substantial overhead memory from earlier consolidation lingers.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severely fails CANSLIM criteria. Q1 FY27 standalone revenue plunged 56% YoY to ₹44.6 crore, while net profit dropped 25% to ₹1.02 crore. Meager return ratios (ROE 2.8%, ROCE 5.6%) and low interest coverage leave the balance sheet vulnerable without institutional sponsorship.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis fails below the 92.26 pivot stop; cut immediately to prevent capital erosion in a fundamentally decaying setup.

ACE.technical: ACE demonstrates a constructive double-bottom base above its rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. A bullish engulfing candle on 1.16x volume applies pressure on the neckline pivot, showcasing resilient relative strength and healthy Stage 2 accumulation in the capital goods space.
ACE.fundamental: Market leader commanding 63% domestic mobile crane share. Q1 FY27 delivered record performance with net profit rising 22.3% YoY to ₹119.5 crore and operational revenues up 20.5%. Boasts elite return metrics (ROCE 31.6%, ROE 22.8%), peak 20.5% EBITDA margins, and a virtually debt-free balance sheet.
ACE.risk: Breakdown below the 1111.18 swing low negates the double-bottom pattern; trigger an immediate stop-loss exit.

AEGISLOG.technical: A textbook high tight flag consolidation near multi-year highs, holding decisively above its 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Volume surged 2.15x on the recent pivot thrust, while RSI at 55 and bullish MACD confirm institutional absorption rather than distribution.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM fundamentals. Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT skyrocketed 269% YoY to ₹484.4 crore on 37% top-line growth to ₹2,357 crore, driven by surging LPG distribution volumes and expanding terminal infrastructure across major ports. Operational leverage remains immense with comfortable balance-sheet leverage.
AEGISLOG.risk: Violation of the 1376.44 consolidation floor invalidates the flag base; cut exposure instantly to honor asymmetric risk control.

AMDIND.technical: Price broke out from a double-bottom base above all moving averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200), propelled by a 3.16x volume expansion. RSI at 67 shows strong momentum; however, historically erratic price action and overhead supply require cautious handling.
AMDIND.fundamental: Shows sharp quarterly turnaround optics, with Q1 FY27 PAT rising over 500% YoY to ₹9.33 crore on 40% revenue growth. However, earnings quality is tempered by erratic historical results, full-year FY26 net losses, low return metrics (ROE 2.1%, ROCE 1.4%), and microcap liquidity constraints.
AMDIND.risk: A close below 64.10 breaches the double-bottom support; exit without hesitation to avoid false breakout whipsaws.

ANANDRATHI.technical: A premier Stage 2 market leader setting up a double-bottom neckline retest. The stock maintains structural strength comfortably above its 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and upward-sloping 200 SMA on 1.41x volume. RSI 56 reflects disciplined consolidation without institutional selling pressure.
ANANDRATHI.fundamental: Elite institutional-grade franchise. Q1 FY27 total revenue jumped 54% YoY to ₹422 crore, with PAT leaping 76% to ₹163 crore. Commands exceptional profitability with 57.5% ROCE, 45.3% ROE, zero net debt, and resilient ~35% operating margins in non-bank wealth management.
ANANDRATHI.risk: Slicing below the 2168.14 structural shelf breaches base integrity; execute an immediate stop to safeguard capital.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Prints a high-octane SEPA breakout to fresh 52-week highs on a massive 9.82x volume deluge. Satisfies Minervini's Trend Template across all timeframes, clearing a 20-session base cleanly above advancing 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with stellar relative strength.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Niche green packaging and soluble films innovator. Q1 FY27 witnessed an explosive bottom-line rebound, with PAT surging 151% YoY to ₹27.4 crore on 111% revenue growth and 41% operating margins. Return profile is sound (ROCE 29.6%, ROE 21.2%) with a virtually debt-free balance sheet.
ARROWGREEN.risk: A drop below 800.89 nullifies the massive breakout candle; cut losses promptly to avoid being trapped in an exhaustion move.
